name: Sombra Guide
description: Interactive 3D map of Fortaleza (Brazil) showing sun position and building shadows for any date and time.
description_good_justification: README explains in the first lines what the software does: an interactive 3D map of Fortaleza showing sun position and building shadows for any date and time. https://github.com/Jaimedsf/sombra-guide/blob/main/README.md
interact_justification: README and CONTRIBUTING explain how to use the live site, report bugs (GitHub issues) and contribute (pull requests). https://github.com/Jaimedsf/sombra-guide/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_justification: Contribution process (fork, branch, npm test, PR against main, CI must pass) is in https://github.com/Jaimedsf/sombra-guide/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_requirements_justification: Requirements (tests for new behaviour, CodeQL clean, code/commit language, no secrets) are in https://github.com/Jaimedsf/sombra-guide/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
documentation_basics_justification: README documents what it does, how to use the map and URL parameters, how to run, build and test, and how it works. https://github.com/Jaimedsf/sombra-guide/blob/main/README.md
documentation_interface_justification: The external interfaces are the URL parameters (?data=, &hora=, #zoom/lat/lng/bearing/pitch) and the src/extra-buildings.json format; both are documented in https://github.com/Jaimedsf/sombra-guide/blob/main/README.md
sites_https_justification: Project site (GitHub Pages) and repository are served only over HTTPS: https://jaimedsf.github.io/sombra-guide/ and https://github.com/Jaimedsf/sombra-guide
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests are searchable, addressable by URL, open to new participants and need no proprietary client. https://github.com/Jaimedsf/sombra-guide/issues
english_justification: Code, comments and commit messages are in English; README has an English summary; issues and PRs are accepted in English or Portuguese.
repo_track_justification: Git tracks every change with author and date.
repo_interim_justification: All interim commits between releases are public on main.
repo_distributed_justification: Git is a distributed version control system.
version_unique_justification: Each release has a unique semantic version (package.json) and git tag, e.g. v1.0.0.
version_tags_justification: Releases are tagged in git as vX.Y.Z. https://github.com/Jaimedsf/sombra-guide/tags
release_notes_justification: Human-readable release notes for every version: https://github.com/Jaimedsf/sombra-guide/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md and https://github.com/Jaimedsf/sombra-guide/releases
release_notes_vulns_justification: No publicly known vulnerabilities have been fixed so far; CHANGELOG.md states that fixed vulnerabilities will be listed with their CVE/GHSA ids.
report_process_justification: Bugs are reported through GitHub issues, as described in CONTRIBUTING.md: https://github.com/Jaimedsf/sombra-guide/issues
report_responses_justification: No bug reports have been received yet (project started in 2026-09); CONTRIBUTING.md commits to a first response within 14 days.
enhancement_responses_justification: No enhancement requests have been received yet; CONTRIBUTING.md commits to a first response within 14 days.
report_archive_justification: Issues and PRs are publicly archived and searchable: https://github.com/Jaimedsf/sombra-guide/issues?q=
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: GitHub private vulnerability reporting is enabled: https://github.com/Jaimedsf/sombra-guide/security/advisories/new
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: SECURITY.md commits to an initial response within 7 days; no reports so far.
build_justification: npm ci && npm run build (Vite) produces the static site in dist/.
build_floss_tools_justification: Node.js, npm and Vite are FLOSS.
test_justification: Automated tests: npm test runs check.mjs and fast-check property tests in test/ (FLOSS, node:test).
test_most_justification: Tests cover the time zone and sun-position logic; the WebGL rendering and UI are not covered by automated tests yet.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: GitHub Actions runs npm test on every push and pull request: https://github.com/Jaimedsf/sombra-guide/blob/main/.github/workflows/deploy.yml
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md requires automated tests for new functionality and for bug fixes: https://github.com/Jaimedsf/sombra-guide/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#política-de-testes
tests_are_added_justification: Recent changes added tests, e.g. property-based tests in test/sun.property.test.js (commit bfa1843).
tests_documented_added_justification: Test policy is documented in CONTRIBUTING.md.
warnings_justification: All JavaScript is ES modules, which always run in strict mode; CodeQL security-and-quality queries run as linter on every push and PR.
warnings_fixed_justification: Findings are fixed, e.g. CodeQL js/unused-local-variable fixed in commit 68bec14; 0 open CodeQL alerts.
warnings_strict_justification: CodeQL security-extended and security-and-quality suites (the strictest provided) are enabled.
know_secure_design_justification: Maintainer applies least privilege (read-only workflow tokens, per-job permissions), minimal attack surface (static site, no backend, no login, no stored user data), and safe defaults.
know_common_errors_justification: Maintainer knows common web errors (OWASP Top 10, e.g. XSS): external data (geocoder results) is only inserted with textContent, never as HTML; dependencies are pinned and audited.
crypto_published_justification: The software does not implement or call cryptography itself; TLS is handled by the browser.
crypto_call_justification: No cryptographic functionality in the project.
crypto_floss_justification: No cryptographic functionality in the project.
crypto_keylength_justification: No cryptographic functionality in the project.
crypto_working_justification: No cryptographic functionality in the project.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: No cryptographic functionality in the project.
crypto_pfs_justification: No key agreement implemented; HTTPS is provided by GitHub Pages and the browser.
crypto_random_justification: No cryptographic keys or nonces are generated.
delivery_mitm_justification: Delivered over HTTPS (GitHub Pages, GitHub, npm registry).
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hashes or artifacts are retrieved over plain HTTP.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No publicly known unpatched vulnerabilities; Dependabot alerts and npm audit report 0.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No critical vulnerabilities reported; Dependabot security updates are enabled.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: The project uses no private credentials; GitHub secret scanning with push protection is enabled.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL (javascript-typescript and actions, security-extended + security-and-quality) runs on every push, PR and weekly: https://github.com/Jaimedsf/sombra-guide/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL security queries target common vulnerabilities such as XSS and injection.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: All CodeQL findings are fixed; currently 0 open alerts.
static_analysis_often_justification: Runs on every commit to main and on every pull request.
dynamic_analysis_justification: Property-based testing with fast-check generates random dates and times and checks invariants on every CI run: https://github.com/Jaimedsf/sombra-guide/blob/main/test/sun.property.test.js
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Tests use node:assert; property tests assert invariants on thousands of generated inputs.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No medium or higher severity issues found by dynamic analysis so far.
